crossrefs.text: The mountains quake before Him, and the hills melt away; the earth trembles at His presence— the world and all its dwellers.
For behold, the LORD comes forth from His dwelling place; He will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
The mountains will melt beneath Him, and the valleys will split apart, like wax before the fire, like water rushing down a slope.
Our God approaches and will not be silent! Consuming fire precedes Him, and a tempest rages around Him.
Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.
Declare among the nations: “The LORD reigns!” The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.
Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea resound, and all that fills it.
Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.
For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
Every man is senseless and devoid of knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols. For his molten images are a fraud, and there is no breath in them.
And again, when God brings His firstborn into the world, He says: “Let all Godʼs angels worship Him.”
May they know that You alone, whose name is the LORD, are Most High over all the earth.
Now I know that the LORD is greater than all other gods, for He did this when they treated Israel with arrogance.”
Mount Zion is glad, the daughters of Judah rejoice, on account of Your judgments.
But those who trust in idols and say to molten images, ‘You are our gods!’ will be turned back in utter shame.
You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath.
To fear the LORD is to hate evil; I hate arrogant pride, evil conduct, and perverse speech.
I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in Me should remain in darkness.
Be patient, then, brothers, until the Lordʼs coming. See how the farmer awaits the precious fruit of the soil—how patient he is for the fall and spring rains.
See how blessed we consider those who have persevered. You have heard of Jobʼs perseverance and have seen the outcome from the Lord. The Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
The path of the righteous is like the first gleam of dawn, shining brighter and brighter until midday.
Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD rises upon you.
For behold, darkness covers the earth, and thick darkness is over the peoples; but the LORD will rise upon you, and His glory will appear over you.
Love must be sincere. Detest what is evil; cling to what is good.
